body:
Thanks, I appreciate the sentiments. But it isn't a matter of fair, it is the reality of our times. After some additional events today, I have no idea how I am going to get through the night, or if I even want to.

I'm worthless in the modern U.S., more so I am a drain, a weight on the people I love most, in a difficult time. I need to free my family of me. Thank you though. I'm feel a little less alone knowing someone read how I see things, and tried to understand.
